cards.text: Jesus has just healed a paralyzed man (Matthew 9:1-8), and now He moves on from there. He spots a man named Matthew sitting at the tax booth. Friend, NOBODY walks past a tax booth thinking, "Ooh, let me go make a new friend over there."

cards.question: Jesus sees Matthew sitting at his tax booth. What does Jesus tell him?
When Jesus calls him, Matthew asks for some time to think it over first.

cards.text: Matthew gets up and follows Him, just like that. Friend, I have taken longer deciding which side of the dough to stamp.

cards.question: Later, Jesus is dining at Matthew's house with His disciples. Who comes and eats with them?

cards.text: So Jesus and His disciples are eating with tax collectors and sinners. Then the Pharisees, a group of religious leaders, see this, and oh, they have QUESTIONS.

cards.question: The Pharisees take their question about the dinner at Matthew's house straight to Jesus.

cards.text: The Pharisees ask His disciples, “Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?” Jesus hears it, and He answers with a picture from everyday life.

cards.question: Jesus says it's not the healthy who need a doctor. It's the ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, “But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’” Friend, that's a line I'd stamp on every cookie in this bakery if it would fit.

cards.question: Jesus says He has not come to call the righteous. He has come to call ___.

cards.text: Then a new group walks up: John's disciples, the followers of John the Baptist. They've got a question about fasting, and they bring the Pharisees into it too.

cards.question: John's disciples say that Jesus's disciples fast more often than they do.

cards.text: John's disciples ask why they and the Pharisees fast often, but Jesus's disciples don't. Jesus replies, “How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while He is with them?”

cards.question: Jesus says the guests can't mourn while the bridegroom is with them. But what time does He say will come?

answers.text: The time the bridegroom is taken from them
The time the guests are all sent home
The time the wedding is called off

cards.text: And then, Jesus says, they will fast. Next picture: an old garment, and friend, after years in a junk drawer, I take old and worn out PERSONALLY.

cards.question: Jesus says no one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. Why not?

answers.text: The patch pulls away and the tear gets worse
The patch is too small to cover the hole
The new cloth fades faster than the old

cards.text: Then one more picture: new wine poured into old wineskins. I bet you can already see where this one's headed.

cards.question: Jesus says pouring new wine into old wineskins makes the skins burst.
Instead, Jesus says, new wine goes into new wineskins. What does He say happens then?
